address: 62 bis avenue des Ostréiculteurs, La Teste-de-Buch, 33260, France
bio: Located at the end of the harbour, this restaurant's terrace with rattan chairs boasts a peaceful view of the boats and oyster port, and feels like an invitation to indulge in a laid-back culinary interlude. The interior decor is also reminiscent of a boat, with its arched bar and light wood open kitchen. The chef Brice Tomico has perfected fresh seafood cuisine, featuring oysters from the hut next door and line-caught fish from Arcachon fish market....
